what_it_does: Covers the structure and/or contents of a home against major natural and man-made risks.
coverage: Flood, inundation, storm, cyclone and other natural calamities
Earthquake damage to structure and contents
Damage to household contents such as furniture, appliances and electronics
Optional cover for jewellery and valuables via add-ons (up to specified limits)
premium_example: ₹18/month for ₹5 lakh sum insured for a pucca building (illustrative only, not an actual quote).
premium_depends_on: Type of dwelling (pucca / kachcha, flat / independent house)
Location risk (flood/quake zone, crime rate, etc.)
Security features (locks, alarms, gated community, etc.)
Policy term (1 year to multi-year options)

structure_and_contents_details.structure_cover: Protects the building structure (walls, roof, floors, built-in fittings) usually on reinstatement value basis, for homes up to a certain age (e.g., 50 years).
structure_and_contents_details.contents_cover: Protects household contents (furniture, appliances, electronics, personal belongings) usually on market value basis after depreciation.

insurer_metrics_notes.claim_settlement_ratio_trend: Health/general CSR typically in a competitive band (approx. mid-80s to 90s depending on product/year).
insurer_metrics_notes.notes: Large private general insurer with strong digital purchase and claim support.

best_for: Homeowners wanting low-cost protection for both structure and contents
Tenants wanting contents-only cover for appliances, furniture and valuables

what_it_does: Protects the residential building and its contents against major natural and man-made risks, with useful living-expense add-ons.
coverage: Loss or damage to building and contents due to fire, lightning and explosion
Damage due to flood, storm, cyclone and other specified natural disasters
Earthquake cover for structure and contents (if opted)
Burglary, theft and housebreaking losses to contents
Electrical and mechanical breakdown cover for specified appliances (if selected)
Coverage for reconstruction/repair of building and replacement of contents after covered events
Rent for alternative accommodation if the insured house becomes uninhabitable (as per chosen limit)
additional_features: Option to cover jewellery on worldwide basis (up to defined limits)
Option to cover portable equipment like mobiles, laptops and cameras on all-risk basis
New-for-old replacement for contents up to a certain age (typically 10 years) in many variants
Auto restoration of loss limit for contents after a claim in some options
Optional covers like hotel stay, brokerage and shifting expenses when moving to alternate accommodation
Discounts based on security and long-term coverage options
who_can_buy: Homeowners for structure-only, contents-only, or combined structure + contents

insurer_metrics_notes.claim_settlement_ratio_trend: Overall claim settlement ratios for general/health business generally in the 90%+ band in recent disclosures (exact numbers vary by segment and year).
insurer_metrics_notes.notes: Known for digital-first processes and wide partner network; home product positioned as long-term, discounted cover.

best_for: Flat or house owners concerned about natural disasters and burglary
Customers who want structure + contents cover plus temporary accommodation benefits
